request: lets add a new feature called important label

spec.title: Add persistent Important label to tasks
spec.summary: Introduce an 'important' flag on tasks that users can toggle from the task list, persisted in the database, with a distinct visual indicator for important tasks.
acceptance: Each task in the list has a toggle control (e.g., a star button) that marks/unmarks it as important.
Toggling the important control immediately persists the new state via the API and survives a page reload.
Tasks marked important are visually distinguished in the list (e.g., a highlight style or 'Important' label class), similar to how completed tasks show the 'done' style.
GET /api/tasks returns the 'important' field for every task.
PATCH /api/tasks/:id accepts an 'important' boolean and updates only that field when provided, without altering 'done' or 'title'.
Newly created tasks default to important = false.
Existing seeded tasks (Task A, Task B, Renew the domain) load with important = false by default after a fresh db/seed.js run.
unchanged: Task creation flow (title input + Add button) is unchanged; no new fields are added to the creation form.
Existing 'done' toggle behavior and styling remain exactly as they are today.
No filtering, sorting, or search behavior is introduced for important tasks.
API routes and response shapes for existing fields (id, title, done) remain unchanged aside from the added 'important' field.
No changes to server port, static file serving, or health check endpoint.
spec.check: Run the app (scripts/start-app or equivalent), load the task list, click the important toggle on a task, confirm it visually changes and reload the page to confirm the state persisted. Also verify GET /api/tasks and PATCH /api/tasks/:id in server.js correctly include/update the important field, and db/seed.js creates the tasks table with an important column defaulting to 0.
spec.reviewFocus: Verify the SQLite schema migration/seed adds the important column correctly, the PATCH endpoint only updates fields explicitly provided in the request body (doesn't reset done or important unintentionally), and the front-end toggle control is accessible (proper aria-label) and updates the DOM/style correctly after persistence.

findings.note: PATCH /api/tasks/:id currently only handles req.body.done; needs to also handle req.body.important as an independent optional boolean update.

tasks table schema needs an 'important INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0' column added; INSERT statements can stay at 2 args (title, done) if important defaults via schema, or be extended to 3 args explicitly set to 0.

toListItem() builds each <li> with a done checkbox; add a similar toggle element (e.g., a star button) wired to a new toggleImportant(id, important) function calling PATCH, and apply a conditional class for the important state.
Not yet reviewed in detail; will need a new style rule for the important state/class (e.g., .important) to visually distinguish the task item.
